title: THE HISTORY OF THE AMERICAN BASEBALL HAT
chaptersLine: Forty-plus chapters drafted, plus an introduction and a closing coda.
spanLine: From before the Civil War to the drops of 2026.
thisWeek: The three rolling production ledgers were refreshed again on October 13, keeping the market read, photo rights, and open questions current.
Revision continues, with the manuscript getting another careful pass.
No new interview notes this week, but the research trail stays warm.
chapterHighlights: The stitched logo that turned a team cap into a sign of belonging.
A cap that spent decades on the sidelines before the street claimed it.
The brim, bent just so: a small act of personal style.
The room where a colorway gets chosen, long before anyone sees it.
